cards.name: Shaymin ◇
cards.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.description: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.description: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Farfetch’d
cards.description: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.description: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.description: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.description: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.description: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.description: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.description: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Tapu Koko ◇
cards.description: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.description: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.description: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.description: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.description: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.description: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.description: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.description: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
